bio.text: Elbert Bartell, also known as Al, is an independent write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Georgia in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Hagerstown, Maryland, served in the U.S. Air Force from 1973 to 1980, and earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Leo University in 1984.
His career experience includes working as a policy analyst.
